hook: Between (間) times there is none (無): almost no gap left, so it happens soon.
Not even (もなく) a gap (間) of time left: it comes soon.
稀 means rare: a unicorn mare (まれ) is very rare.
Go around (回り) + road (道): a road that goes the long way around, a detour.
See (見) + down (下ろす): look down from a high place.
The moon (月) on day three (三日) of its cycle: a thin crescent.
惨 means cruel or tragic: a bullied (いじめ, close in sound) child feels miserable.
Shop (店) + seller's house (屋): a shop.
Road (道) + order (順): the order of roads to take, your route.
See (見) + pack tight (詰める): keep your eyes packed on one thing, stare.
See (見) + get used to (慣れる): you see it so often it feels normal.
醜 means ugly: みにくい sounds like 見にくい, hard to look at.
実 means fruit: a plant makes its fruit (実), it ripens.
See (見) + basis (本): the thing you look at as the model, a sample.
See (見) + dance (舞う): visit a sick friend and cheer them up.
Name (名) + character (字): the family name characters you write first.
People (民) + among (間): among ordinary people, not the government.
People (民) + master (主): the people are the masters, democratic.
People (民) + song (謡): songs of ordinary people, folk songs.
No (無) + limit (限): without limit, infinite.
No (無) + pattern on the base cloth (地): nothing on it, plain.
Spear (矛) + shield (盾): a spear that pierces all and a shield that stops all, a contradiction.
群 means group, and it has sheep (羊) inside: a flock of sheep.
Woman (女) + arrive (至): the little girl who arrives in your sibling's family, your niece.
Famous (名) + work (作): a famous work, a masterpiece.
Famous (名) + place (所): a famous place.
Astray (迷) + belief (信): a belief that leads you astray, superstition.
命 means command (and life): to give a command.
銘 is a name carved on something: each person has their own, so each one.
恵 means blessing: to receive blessings, to be blessed with.
巡 means patrol or tour: walk around in a circle like a patrol officer.
Eye (目) + wake (覚): the thing that opens your eyes, an alarm clock.
Below (下) your eyes (目): read めした it means someone below you; read もっか, what is before you now.
Eye (目) + mark (印): a mark for your eyes, a landmark.
Eye (目) + stand (立つ): it stands up in your eyes, it stands out.
Surface (面) + product (積): length times width of a surface, area.
Trouble (面倒) + smelly (臭い): a task that stinks of trouble, so annoying.
儲 means profit: more cash (もうかる) comes in, it pays.
儲 means profit: you make money (儲ける), while with 儲かる money comes to you.
Wood (木) + material (材): wood used as material, timber.
Item (目) + order (次): the items in order, the table of contents.
潜 means dive or hide, with water (氵) on the left: go under the water.
凭 means lean on, with a small table (几) under it: lean on the table.
Origin (元) twice: from the very origin, originally.
Thing (物) + tell (語る): tell the story of things (物語 is a story).
Thing (物) + fierce (凄い): something fierce and amazing, tremendous.
Hand (扌) + soft (柔): hands rub something to make it soft.
催 means hold (an event): something held for people, an event.
盛 means pile up: pile food high on a plate.
Question (問) + answer (答): questions and answers.
喧 has a mouth (口): mouths making noise, so noisy (like 喧嘩, a fight).
Night (夜) + interval (間): the time during the night.
Role (役) + person (者): a person who plays a role, an actor.
Medicine (薬) + goods (品): medicines and chemical goods.
Fire (火) + wound (傷): a wound from fire, a burn.
Arrow (矢) + mark (印): an arrow mark.
House (家) + owner (主): the owner of the house, the landlord.
破 means tear or break: tear paper, like 破る.
軟 means soft (as in 柔軟, flexible): soft and tender.
Evening (夕) + publish (刊): the paper published in the evening.
Evening (夕) + stand up (立): rain that suddenly stands up in the evening.
Evening (夕) + sun (日): the setting sun.
悠 means calm and far away: doubled, very calm and relaxed.
Have (有) + fee (料): there is a fee, it is paid.
Go (行) + direction (方): the direction someone went, their whereabouts.
Hot water (湯) + air (気): air rising from hot water, steam.
Transport (輸) + blood (血): moving blood into someone, a transfusion.
Transport (輸) + send (送): sending things by transport.
Hot water (湯) + drink (飲み): a cup for drinking hot tea.
Hot water (湯) + drink (飲): a cup for hot drinks, a teacup.
緩 has thread (糸): a slack thread, so loose or slow.
Melt (溶) + rock (岩): melted rock, lava.
Use (用) + word (語): words used in a field, terms.
Main point (要) + meaning (旨): the main meaning, the gist.
Young (幼) + child (児): a very young child.
Contain (容) + amount (積): how much it can contain, its volume.
Young (幼) + immature (稚): like a little kid, childish.
Little kids (幼稚) + garden (園): a garden for little kids, kindergarten.
Use (用) + way (途): the way something is used.
Western (洋) + goods (品) + shop (店): a shop for Western clothes and goods.
Nourish (養) + part (分): the part that nourishes, nutrients.
Sheep (羊) + hair (毛): wool.
漸 means gradually: step by step, until at last.
Waist (要) + neck (領): the two key parts of the body, so the key points, the gist.
Desire (欲) + stretch (張り): stretching your desires too far, greedy.
Other (余) + place (所): some other place.
Four (四つ) + corner (角): where four corners meet, a crossroads.
Drunk (酔) + sweep away (払い): so drunk his sense is swept away, a drunkard.
Before (予) + prepare (備): prepared beforehand, a spare.
Call (呼び) + hang on (掛ける): hang your call on someone, call out to them.
Call (呼び) + out (出す): call someone out, summon them.
蘇 means revive: return (かえる) from the underworld (よみ), come back to life.
慶 means celebration: be glad, like at a celebration.
Come (来) + Japan (日, short for 日本): come to Japan.
Fall (落) + grade (第): fall out of your grade, fail.
欄 has wood (木) and means railing: a boxed-in column in a newspaper or form.
Profit (利) + harm (害): gains and losses, interests.
略 means shorten or omit: cut a word short, abbreviate.
Flow (流) + area (域): the area where a river flows, its basin.
Territory (領) + affairs (事): an official who handles his country's affairs in a foreign city, a consul.
Receive (領) + collect (収): proof you received money, a receipt.
Zero (零) + points (点): zero points.
Row (列) + island (島): islands in a row, a chain of islands.
Fire-refined (煉) + tile (瓦): clay fired hard like a tile, a brick.
Link (連) + join (合): groups linked and joined together, a union.
Rome (ローマ) + letters (字): Roman letters.
Record (録) + sound (音): recording sound.
論 means argument or theory: to argue or discuss.
Japan (和) + England (英): Japanese to English.
Young (若) twice: very young looking, youthful.
詫 has words (言): use words to apologize.
Japanese (和) + clothes (服): Japanese clothes, like a kimono.
Divide (割) + match (合): comparing proportions, so relatively.
Divide (割) + calculate (算): division.
